decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed first floor side extension and pitched roof over existing rear extension, because of its position, design and appearance would not harm neighbours' living conditions, the appearance of the area or highway safety. 	The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments.) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 8 Lampton Avenue.
Condition : 6 - The window formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension with pitched roof over existing rear extension to house.
